mapper.sql: ( SELECT MAX(PI.IMG_PATH || PI.SAVE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PI.IMG_ORDER, PI.IMG_NO) FROM PLACE_IMG PI WHERE PI.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PI.DEL_YN = 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT P.PLACE_NO AS placeNo, P.PLACE_NAME AS placeName, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION AS placeDescription, P.ADDR AS addr, P.ADDR_DETAIL AS addrDetail, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.X_AXIS AS xAxis, P.Y_AXIS AS yAxis, P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO AS typeDetailNo, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT AS typeDetail, T.TYPE AS type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLACE_REVIEW R WHERE R.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS reviewCount, (SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0.0) FROM PLACE_REVIEW R WHERE R.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND R.DEL_YN = 'N') AS avgRating, CASE WHEN #{memberNo} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLACE_BOOKMARK PB WHERE PB.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND PB.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS bookmarkYn FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT IMG_NO AS imgNo, PLACE_NO AS placeNo, ORIGINAL_NAME AS originalName, SAVE_NAME AS saveName, IMG_PATH AS imgPath, IMG_PATH || SAVE_NAME AS imageUrl, IMG_ORDER AS imgOrder FROM PLACE_IMG WHERE PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY IMG_ORDER, IMG_NO
SELECT T.TAG_NO AS tagNo, T.TAG_CONTENT AS tagContent FROM PLACE_TAG PT JOIN TAG T ON PT.TAG_NO = T.TAG_NO WHERE PT.PLACE_NO = #{placeNo} ORDER BY T.TAG_NO
SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P WHERE P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = #{typeDetailNo} AND P.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO

SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE, T.TYPE, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT AS TYPE_DETAIL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO

SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE, T.TYPE, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT AS TYPE_DETAIL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND (T.TYPE = #{type} OR TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT = #{type}) ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO

SELECT P.PLACE_NO, P.PLACE_NAME, P.PLACE_DESCRIPTION, P.ADDR, P.ADDR_DETAIL, P.PHONE_NUMBER AS PHONE, T.TYPE, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT AS TYPE_DETAIL, P.VIEW_COUNT, P.X_AXIS, P.Y_AXIS, AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE P.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLACE_TAG PT JOIN TAG TG ON PT.TAG_NO = TG.TAG_NO WHERE PT.PLACE_NO = P.PLACE_NO AND TG.TAG_CONTENT = #{tag} ) ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO

SELECT T.TYPE_NO AS typeNo, T.TYPE AS type, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO AS typeDetailNo, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_CONTENT AS typeDetailContent FROM TYPE T LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON T.TYPE_NO = TD.TYPE_NO ORDER BY T.TYPE_NO, TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO
SELECT TAG_NO AS tagNo, TAG_CONTENT AS tagContent FROM TAG ORDER BY TAG_NO

SELECT P.PLACE_NO ,P.PLACE_NAME ,P.ADDR ,P.X_AXIS ,P.Y_AXIS ,P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO , AS IMAGE_URL FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO WHERE P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = #{typeDetailNo} ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO ASC
